facts.fact: Reserve Bank of Malawi payments director Angella Mjojo said several regulations were in preparation and would come out very soon, and that high transaction costs are addressed through the quarterly National Payments Council.
Complaints about failed mobile money transactions go to the Reserve Bank of Malawi's consumer protection wing after customers first approach their provider, per Director Angella Mjojo.

MWI.note: No cross-border payment channel is stated.
The e-government secretary speaks of digital payments but no government online service is stated.
No government payment to people is stated.
The KYC lookup checks a recipient's name; no check against the national ID is stated.
No survey share of adults with an account is given.

facts.fact: Airtel Money mobile money is in service in Malawi, its managing director saying improved connectivity has driven growth in digital transactions.

MWI.note: No payment of taxes or fees is stated.
